items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: But I remember an old trombone man back there, used to call him Jim Robinson I think

ctx.x: You don't, no, you wouldn't remember George Bocquet?

No, I remember Peter, Peter Bocquet. Peter Bocquet. Peter Bocquet, I think he, I remember him, because I think at the time I left New Orleans he was President of the Union. But no, I don't remember Peter, the other fellow that played clarinet. But I remember an old trombone man back there, used to call him Jim Robinson I think, big,
tall, slender fellow. Yeah, yeah. He plays George Lewis. Oh yeah.
